articles.summary: LOS ANGELES, April 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Playboy, Inc. (Nasdaq: PLBY) (“Playboy” or the “Company”), a global pleasure and leisure company, will release financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026 after Nasdaq closes on Monday, May 11, 2026.
articles.title: Playboy to Host First Quarter 2026 Earnings Call on May 11, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time
